Tone Frequency Generator

Generate a pure tone at any frequency from 20 Hz to 20 kHz — choose sine, square, sawtooth or triangle waves, with volume control.

440 Hz

⚠️ Start at low volume, especially with headphones.

📖 How to use

  1. Set the frequency with the slider or type it exactly.
  2. Pick a waveform.
  3. Press Play and adjust the volume.
  4. Slide the frequency live to sweep.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What frequency range is supported?

20 Hz to 20,000 Hz — the full range of human hearing — set by slider or exact number.

Which waveforms are available?

Sine (pure), triangle (soft), square (hollow) and sawtooth (buzzy).

Can I sweep the frequency live?

Slide the frequency while playing to sweep — useful for finding rattles or testing speakers.

Is it safe for my ears?

Keep the volume low, especially with headphones, and avoid long exposure to very high volumes.
